environment.os: Linux aarch64 sandbox - REBUILT WITH -fsigned-char (see substrate note)
environment.note: SUBSTRATE FINDING: on unsigned-char platforms (Linux aarch64 default) CDP's textfile parser rejects EVERY text input ('<name> is not a valid CDP file') because initial_parse_textfile's '(char)fgetc() != EOF' loop never sees EOF (cdparse.c). All binaries rebuilt with -fsigned-char (every per-directory CMakeLists clobbers CMAKE_C_FLAGS - sed-patched). macOS (signed char) unaffected; gate renders verified byte-identical across the rebuild. To be re-verified on macOS r8 by the CDP-gated suite after integration.
